technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot 2.x / 3.x for ModuleRunner implementation to align with Spring Framework 6.0 baseline (Java 17+).
Adopt Maven as build tool for CI _install_ target addition, leveraging existing Spring XD build structure.
Implement pluggable runtime SPI for module deployment using Spring's ServiceLoader mechanism or @ConditionalOnMissingBean patterns.
Use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for TupleBuilder and jdbchdfs performance benchmarking.
Leverage Testcontainers for integration testing of Sqoop jobs with SQLServer and GPDB.
Publish XD + Kafka POC as a standalone sample project in Spring Samples GitHub org with README and Docker Compose for reproducibility.
DEBS challenge completion assumes existing codebase for event processing; focus on final integration, packaging, and submission artifacts.
Simplified GPDB parameter UX will introduce a new ParameterParser abstraction with dialect-specific implementations (GPDB, SQLServer).
assumptions: Developer has deep familiarity with Spring XD, Spring Boot, and the existing codebase.
CI infrastructure (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) is already configured; only new job definition needed for _install_ target.
Performance benchmark environment (hardware, network, data sets) is available and stable.
XD + Kafka POC code is functionally complete; only packaging, documentation, and publishing effort required.
DEBS challenge submission deadline is within the sprint; no major new feature development, only polishing.
Sqoop installation and GPDB/SQLServer test instances are accessible for U6 testing.
Module deployment SPI migration is limited to stream/job module definitions; no changes to core container lifecycle.
ModuleRunner will reuse existing Spring XD module execution logic, refactored as a Spring Boot auto-configuration.
All estimates are for a single developer working full-time with no context-switching overhead.
No major refactoring of unrelated legacy code is required unless explicitly stated in a story.

activities.activity_description: Integrate remaining DEBS challenge components, run full test suite, fix failures, and validate against challenge requirements.
Create deployable artifacts (JAR/Docker image), write submission documentation, and submit before deadline.
Design CI pipeline stage for _install_ target: define triggers, environment, artifact promotion, and verification steps.

activities.activity_name: CI Build - Implement _install_ Target in Build Scripts
activities.activity_description: Add Maven/Gradle _install_ target to pom.xml/build.gradle, configure publishing to local/remote repo, and integrate with CI job.
Run end-to-end verification of _install_ target in CI, document usage for developers, and add to contribution guide.

activities.activity_name: XD+Kafka POC - Prepare Sample Project Structure
activities.activity_description: Create GitHub repo in Spring Samples, set up Maven/Gradle multi-module structure, add license, README template, and CI badge.

activities.activity_name: XD+Kafka POC - Refactor & Package POC Code
activities.activity_description: Clean up POC code: remove hardcoded configs, externalize properties, add Docker Compose for Kafka/Zookeeper/XD, ensure Java 17+ compatibility.
Write comprehensive README with architecture diagram, setup instructions, run guide, and link to XD blog. Publish release tag.
Provision benchmark cluster, deploy HDFS/Hive, configure jdbchdfs connector, generate representative data sets (100GB+).

activities.activity_name: Benchmark - Implement JMH Benchmarks for jdbchdfs
activities.activity_description: Write JMH benchmarks covering read/write throughput, predicate pushdown, partition pruning, and connection pooling scenarios.
Run benchmarks before/after optimizations, collect metrics (throughput, latency, GC), generate comparison report with charts.
Identify TupleBuilder hot paths: tuple creation, field access, serialization, schema evolution. Define micro/macro benchmarks.
Code JMH benchmarks for TupleBuilder: object allocation rates, memory footprint, serialization overhead, vs. alternative implementations.
Run profiles (async-profiler/JFR), apply optimizations (object pooling, lazy init, intrinsics), validate gains, document changes.
Design ParameterParser SPI with dialect implementations (GPDB, SQLServer), escaping rules, and integration points in Sqoop job config.

activities.activity_name: GPDB UX - Implement GPDB & SQLServer Dialects
activities.activity_description: Implement GPDBParameterParser (simplified escaping) and SQLServerParameterParser, add unit tests for edge cases (quotes, nulls, types).

activities.activity_name: GPDB UX - Sqoop Integration Testing with Testcontainers
activities.activity_description: Write integration tests using Testcontainers for GPDB and SQLServer: run Sqoop import/export jobs, verify parameter handling, data fidelity.
Update user docs: new parameter syntax, migration from old escaping, dialect configuration examples.

activities.activity_name: Module Deployment - Design Pluggable Runtime SPI
activities.activity_description: Define ModuleDeploymentRuntime SPI interface, configuration model, and Spring Boot auto-configuration integration points.

activities.activity_name: Module Deployment - Implement Repository Abstraction Migration
activities.activity_description: Refactor existing repository-based deployment to new SPI: create DefaultModuleDeploymentRuntime, deprecate old classes, update wiring.
Write unit/integration tests for SPI implementations, verify backward compatibility with existing stream/job definitions, test pluggability.
Design ModuleRunner as Spring Boot application: module lifecycle, classloader isolation, health endpoints, config mapping from XD properties.
Implement ModuleRunnerApplication, ModuleDeployer, ModuleRegistry, and container-managed deployment logic (no xd-container dependency).
Test in Docker/Kubernetes: build image, define Helm chart, verify module deployment, scaling, logging, and config refresh.
Write reference documentation: deployment modes, configuration properties, migration from xd-container, sample docker-compose.yml.
